subtasks.title: UniqueLprCaseClaimsQuery -- the single-pass ClickHouse claims funnel
subtasks.approach: New bespoke query class. Port claimsCte() + deduped from backyard RepoReport.php (origin/deploy), using the ALREADY PRODUCTION-VALIDATED SQL in docs/investigations/DEV-2463/measure-claims-card.sql verbatim rather than re-deriving it. Hard requirements, each measured or read from source: (1) SINGLE PASS -- count()/countIf(success)/uniqExactIf((forwarder,agent,vin), success AND vin != '') from ONE scan; three CTE references cost 3x the read_rows (119.8M vs 39.9M, measured). (2) Dedup on the FULL 3-column key, not the docblock's stale 2-column prose. (3) event_type from BillingEventType::CASE_CLAIM->value (already vendored in black-adam), never a string literal; ls-claim excluded. (4) insightlpr excluded by an EXPLICIT SQL org-name predicate -- LEFT JOIN zod.public_orgs FINAL on both axes, lower(replaceRegexpAll(name,'[^a-zA-Z0-9]','')) then a position() needle. It is a no-op against today's data (only org 1 has ever been a case-claim forwarder, 0 successful), which is exactly why it must be explicit and tested. titlemax NEVER filtered. (5) FINAL + _peerdb_is_deleted=0 on api_keys and orgs (small); _peerdb_is_deleted=0 WITHOUT FINAL on billing_events (raw==FINAL, and FINAL costs real time for nothing -- but the filter is still correctness-required because that table's engine carries no _peerdb_is_deleted merge argument). (6) Explicit 'UTC' in every date function. (7) Bucketed by toStartOfMonth over 13 months in the SAME query -- measured FREE (read_rows byte-identical across 1/3/13-month spans). (8) Runs on the clarity_clickhouse connection with fully-qualified zod.public_* names, for its max_bytes_before_external_group_by = 10 GB. (9) Does NOT extend the ClickhouseQuery base class -- its query() swallows Throwable to [], and a genuine 0 is a known-normal reading on this card (12 of 29 entitled orgs on the Today filter), so a failure MUST be distinguishable. Own try/catch + report().
subtasks.intended_diffs: New query class exposing two entry points: a 13-month bucketed series for the sparkline and a single-window scalar for today/last_7d, both one round trip. New feature test using RequiresClickhouse, seeding zod.public_billing_events + zod.public_api_keys + zod.public_orgs.
subtasks.tdd: Write the feature test FIRST and confirm red->green. It pins the RULES, not the production number (15,128 is not reproducible in CI): the 3-column dedup key -- specifically that one agent claiming the same VIN through TWO forwarders counts as TWO groups, the case the stale docblock prose under-counts; insightlpr excluded even in a success=true/vin-set fixture production cannot currently produce; titlemax NOT excluded; ls-claim excluded; event_type not type; UTC calendar-month inclusive BETWEEN on integer ts; the either-side org axis; a NULL agent_org_id counting on the forwarder side only without double-counting; and that a ClickHouse failure raises rather than returning 0.

open_risks_carried_into_implementation.risk: TIMEZONE CONFLICT, found while planning -- not in prep, not in the ticket. DashboardWidget::getMonthlyData() builds its month boundaries from `auth()->user()->timezone ?? 'UTC'` (line 218), but this metric's port rule 2 requires a UTC calendar month to reproduce Brek's figures. So the overridden getMonthlyData() MUST bucket by UTC, which means this card's monthly buckets are defined differently from every other card's on the same dashboard (user-tz).
open_risks_carried_into_implementation.resolution: Bucket by UTC -- the AC that the card reproduce 15,128/14,288/11,975 is explicit and the reproduction is UTC-anchored. Document the divergence in the class docblock and the Build Record. Do NOT quietly inherit the user-tz boundary: for a user in America/Chicago that shifts the month by 5-6 hours and silently breaks the cross-check.

open_risks_carried_into_implementation.risk: Epoch bounds must be derived from Carbon's UTC-anchored ->timestamp, never hand-computed. The driver's own first measurement hand-computed them, landed silently 2 days off, and returned 14,313/13,492/11,433 -- close enough to look plausible.
open_risks_carried_into_implementation.resolution: Derive from Carbon; assert the boundary in the feature test.
